descriptions.text: Bring a golden glow to your designs with the Gilded Wings Accents. This laser-cut sheet includes delicate gold foil butterflies in a mix of styles and sizes, giving you plenty of ways to dress up cards, scrapbooking layouts, and other paper projects. Just add adhesive and let these light-catching embellishments do the heavy lifting for a special finishing touch. DETAILS - 1 sheet of laser-cut designs - Sheet size: 12" x 12" (30.5 x 30.5 cm) - Acid and lignin free (this product is photo-safe) - Color: Gold
